title: 交互系统不完善
description: 交互系统存在缺陷，如投降海盗无法控制、隐藏交互缺乏提示、太空警察遭遇缺乏应对选项等，影响玩家交互体验。
evidence: I've never had any control whatsoever over them. Can't even ask them to drop their weapon, frisk them, or restrain them
some refinement of the interaction system wouldn't go amiss
The command order also changes, so I mixed up “slap” and “stab” more than once.

evidence_items.quote: The command order also changes, so I mixed up “slap” and “stab” more than once.
evidence_items.description: 战斗指令顺序会变化，导致误操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 命令顺序也会变化，所以我不止一次把“扇耳光”和“捅刺”搞混了。

evidence_items.quote: I've never had any control whatsoever over them. Can't even ask them to drop their weapon, frisk them, or restrain them
evidence_items.description: 投降的海盗无法被下达指令或控制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我对他们从来没有任何控制权。甚至不能叫他们放下武器、搜他们的身，或者把他们绑起来

evidence_items.quote: I still don’t understand exactly how to choose whether the character will walk to the switch or click it
evidence_items.description: 不清楚角色是走向开关还是点击开关
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我仍然不完全明白如何选择角色是走到开关那里还是点击它

evidence_items.quote: No proof, no warrant, no arrest, no escape, no future, all you can do is talk to space-cop.
evidence_items.description: 被太空警察登船后无法脱离，只能与其对话，无法逃脱或采取其他行动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有证据，没有搜查令，没有逮捕，没有逃脱，没有未来，你所能做的只是和太空警察说话。

evidence_items.quote: it’s not a clickable object on the wall, you must first have the insane presence of mind to right click the sink, select the sink, then select the mirror from there
evidence_items.description: 镜子不是可点击物体，需要右键水槽再选择镜子
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它不是墙上的可点击物体，你必须首先有那种疯狂的镇定，右键点击水槽，选择水槽，然后从那里选择镜子

evidence_items.quote: some refinement of the interaction system wouldn't go amiss
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对交互系统做一些改进也不会有什么坏处
